summary: The DisciplineLookups service is a web service that provides discipline lookups for AJAX Toolkit cascading dropdowns. It facilitates the retrieval of codes and descriptions for discipline categories and their sub-disciplines.
purpose: To provide discipline lookups for AJAX Toolkit cascading dropdowns, allowing users to retrieve and display discipline categories and sub-disciplines in a hierarchical selection interface.

fields.name: knownCategoryValues
fields.description: A string passed to the web service containing known category values.

fields.name: category
fields.description: A string that includes the session hash and discipline category.

fields.name: contextKey
fields.description: An optional context key used in the discipline lookup process.

workflows.name: GetDisciplines
steps: Split the 'category' parameter to extract the session hash.
Retrieve the session ID from the hash.
Fetch code categories list based on the session ID and 'Disciplines%'
Return list of CascadingDropDownNameValue objects with categories and IDs.

exceptions.description: Occurs if the knownCategoryValues string does not contain a valid code category ID.
